hypothesis: A VCP breakout is more likely to receive follow-through when demand is diffusing through a contemporaneous co-moving peer group, even when point-in-time industry membership is unavailable.

peer_definition.correlation_window: 63 completed trading returns ending before signal day
peer_definition.selection: highest positive Pearson correlations; candidate excluded

decision_rule: Continue this mechanism only if at least one peer-demand feature is directionally positive in at least 7 of 10 usable calendar years and its highest within-year quintile improves true-breakout rate by at least 5 percentage points over its lowest quintile without reversing continuous 40-day return. Otherwise stop. No feature cutoff or strategy rule may be selected from this audit.
anti_overfit: One quarterly correlation window and one 20-peer representation are fixed as a representative mechanism test. No alternative window, peer count, correlation floor, feature combination, model, portfolio backtest, or neighboring variant is allowed after seeing the result.
causal_limit: Dynamic peers are a price-derived proxy for shared sponsorship, not proof of industry identity or common fundamentals. Future paths are labels only.
